source = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    row_candidates = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == separator for v in row) >= 0.7 * w]
    col_candidates = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h)) >= 0.7 * h]
    marked_rows = [r for r in row_candidates if any(grid[r][c] != separator for c in col_candidates)]
    marked_cols = [c for c in col_candidates if any(grid[r][c] != separator for r in row_candidates)]
    if not marked_rows or not marked_cols:
        return []
    row_lines = [r for r in row_candidates if marked_rows[0] <= r <= marked_rows[-1]]
    col_lines = [c for c in col_candidates if marked_cols[0] <= c <= marked_cols[-1]]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = [grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci]], grid[row_lines[ri]][col_lines[ci + 1]],
                       grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci]], grid[row_lines[ri + 1]][col_lines[ci + 1]]]
            value = corners[0] if corners[0] != separator and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else background
            row.append(value)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
